tldr: Midday batch, Aug 26 — Open-weight week keeps rolling: Thomson Reuters open-weights Thomson-1.0-Small, its first in-house legal/tax LLM (continual learning on a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B base with Westlaw data, debuting in CoCounsel Legal), while Qwen3.8-27B claims #9 on Code Arena as the only sub-30B model in the top 10 and a new NVFP4 quantization (QUASAR QAD) pushes 4-bit quality toward full precision. Research: Apodex 1.1 (scaling agentic intelligence, HF paper of the day) and extrapolative video world models via latent dynamics reasoning. Hermes: Teknium details his --worktree --yolo parallel dev workflow. Local-AI economics: a Mac Studio M5 Max cost thread puts DeepSeek V4 Flash at ~100B tokens per $10k of hardware.
